customers.evidence: We believe our first responsibility is to the doctors, nurses and patients, to mothers and fathers and all others who use our products and services.

employees.evidence: We are responsible to our employees, the men and women who work with us throughout the world.

dei.evidence: There must be equal opportunity for employment, development and advancement for those qualified.

environment.evidence: protecting the environment and natural resources

community.evidence: We are responsible to the communities in which we live and work and to the world community as well.

shareholders.evidence: Our final responsibility is to our stockholders.

integrity.evidence: We must provide competent management, and their actions must be just and ethical.

safety.evidence: working conditions clean, orderly and safe

innovation.evidence: Research must be carried on, innovative programs developed and mistakes paid for.

result.analyst_notes: Prescriptive, first-person plural voice built on 'must' and 'responsible to', ordered as a sequence of stakeholder duties: customers first, then employees, communities and stockholders. Framed through the 1943 Credo, with 'We believe' hedging the business-success claim. Commitments are absolute, while environment and safety appear only briefly.
